newsitem.title: USA: Wellco records sought in antitrust probe.
newsitem.headline: Wellco records sought in antitrust probe.

text.p: Wellco Enterprises Inc on Wednesday said the U.S. Justice Department served the company with a subpoena for certain records as part of an antitrust investigation.
A federal grand jury is seeking documents dated from January 1, 1990, through April 29, 1997, in a probe of alleged collusion of companies that make combat boots for the U.S. military, Wellco said.
Wellco said it has not engaged in any illegal conduct and intended to cooperate with the grand jury.
The investigation is believed to include all U.S. manufacturers of combat boots for the U.S. government, the company said.

In 1988, the company and other combat boot makers responded to subpoenas in a similar investigation involving bids on combat boot procurements between 1979 and 1988, but no legal action resulted after the investigation was closed in 1992, Wellco said.
